messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 95th pct latency on /v1/generate (hosted region-us-west). Sampling shows queue depth growth and timeout spikes. Paging oncall channel now.
sasha: taking. grabbing metrics + traces. any customer reports yet?
matt: seeing a lot of 504s at the frontdoor LB and runtime logs show repeated 'kv-cache miss' and 'enqueue_timeout' warnings.
sasha: good catch. looks like a sudden shift in seq_len distribution from customers A and B (long prompts).
kate: are we on the new batching config? might be batching blowup.
carl: yes, autoscaler didn't scale quickly; queue backed up. max_inflight currently 192 on this pool. runtime queueing metric: inflight==192, pending==840.
sasha: plan: 1) reduce max_inflight to 80 on region-us-west runtime pool; 2) enable soft-shedding for non-pay routes; 3) disable streaming responses for large-gen endpoints as temporary; 4) bump per-customer rate-limit for affected enterprise to avoid retries.
matt: +1. I'll deploy the max_inflight change now. command: `redwoodctl runtime update --pool us-west-gen --max-inflight 80`
matt: deploying... getting confirmation from runtime API: `200 OK`
ops-bot: config-change: runtime pool us-west-gen max_inflight set 192 -> 80 by matt at 4372023045
sasha: applying soft-shedding config for unauthenticated and embed routes: set shed-level=aggressive. snippet:
```
{
  "routes": ["/v1/embeddings","/v1/open*"],
  "policy": "soft_shed",
  "priority": "drop_low",
  "min_success_rate": 0.9
}
```
kate: disabling streaming on /v1/generate for hosted tier to avoid long-lived connections. matt, can you flip the flag in the router?
matt: flipping flag `router toggle --route /v1/generate --streaming off` -> success. ops-bot: router change applied.
support-bot: support: customer A reported degraded throughput at 09:02; CS notified. ticket #CS-4281 created.
sasha: after max_inflight change, pending queue dropped from 840 -> 120 over 90s. 95th latency trending down.
carl: telemetry shows CPU and mem per-worker stable; KV misses still high for long prompts (we should evict early).
sasha: next action: tune request timeout to 30s (was 20s) to reduce tail 504s during drain, and add a temporary per-account quota bump for enterprise customers A/B to let them finish inflight requests.
matt: applying timeout change: `redwoodctl runtime update --pool us-west-gen --request-timeout 30s` -> OK.
ops-bot: policy-change: request_timeout set 20s -> 30s by matt at 4372023068
sasha: creating per-customer temporary quota bump: customer A limit +50% for 1h, customer B +30% for 1h. support-team will message customers.
support-bot: CS update sent to customer A and B: we increased temporary capacity and are working on a long-term fix.
kate: logs show a small subset of clients still retrying aggressively. recommend adding a short-ttl retry-after header on 429s to prevent stampeding.
carl: adding header change now in edge: `edge config set rate-limit-retry-after 8s` -> applied.
sasha: monitoring for customer impact — any errors left?
matt: error-rate back to baseline for most routes. still seeing some embed timeouts but shedding covers that.
sasha: will keep this thread open for 30m. afterwards we'll schedule a follow-up to adjust batching heuristics and KV cache sizing. good work. :thumbsup:
